title: Marimac's Maison
meta_description: Find the perfect 30A, FL vacation rental at “Marimac's Maison”, a luxury 6-bed, 6 bath vacation rental. Ideal for 16 guests, this home offers a Private Pool, Elevator & Golf Cart for your enjoyment. Book your memorable stay now!
description_expanded: Home Highlights - Elevator - Easy Beach Access - Private Pool & Spa - 6 seater Golf Cart - 6 adult Bikes Thoughtfully designed for exceptional coastal living, this elegant beach retreat blends timeless craftsmanship with upscale amenities to create the ultimate Gulf Coast getaway. Rich pine floors, custom wainscoting, exposed beam and tray ceilings, a residential elevator, and two gourmet kitchens set the stage for a truly elevated vacation experience. Gather with family and friends in the expansive top-floor living area, where panoramic Gulf views and over 1,000 square feet of furnished balcony space provide the perfect backdrop for every moment. The chef's kitchen features premium Wolf appliances, granite countertops, a wine cooler, and generous dining space ideal for large groups. Just beyond, the spacious living room opens to a Gulf-facing balcony overlooking the private pool below. The home's thoughtfully designed layout offers multiple private retreats, including a luxurious king suite on the upper level with its own balcony and spa-like bath. Two additional king suites with Gulf-view balconies, walk-in closets, and soaking tubs occupy the second floor, along with a bunk room and convenient laundry area. On the ground level, guests will find a versatile entertainment space complete with additional sleeping accommodations, a full kitchen, and easy access to the outdoor oasis. Surrounded by lush landscaping, the private courtyard features a sparkling pool, relaxing spa, outdoor shower, patio seating, and a gas grill, perfect for afternoons in the sun and evenings spent dining under the stars. Sleeping Arrangements First Floor - In Law Suite w/ Queen Murphy Bed & Sleeper Sofa w/ Private Bathroom w/ Shower/Tub Combo - Bunkroom Second Floor - King Bedroom w/ Private Bathroom w/ Shower/Tub Combo - King Bedroom w/ Private Bathroom w/ Shower/Tub Combo - Twin over Twin Bunkroom w/ Private Bathroom w/ Shower/Tub Combo Third Floor - King Bedroom w/ Private Bathroom w/ Shower/Tub Combo - Half Bathroom
